description: Eleven captured searches covered English/French monthly discovery, all four date windows in both languages, and local outlet/sector discovery for women, teachers, health workers, electricity and regional terms including Yaounde, Douala, Bamenda, Buea, Bafoussam, Ngaoundere, Ebolowa and Ekona. Open web only; no systematic equivalents of historical press archives. Many Cameroonian local languages beyond English/French were not searched.
required_followup: Further bounded review can search additional specific local-language outlets and regional terms; do not claim comprehensive coverage.

description: One contemporaneous VOA body supports the March 8 Yaounde protest and qualitative hundreds threshold. Search results with same headline have not established an independent original story or distinct site-level corroboration.
required_followup: Seek a distinct contemporary local report on the Yaounde protest and separate site-level evidence for other towns; do not treat same-headline copies or parade attendance as independent corroboration.

description: The March 19 Cabral Libii-related action included a brief alternate-site demonstration, but sources do not establish 50 simultaneous participants. They also do not clarify whether demand targeted Cameroon state policy, ENEO, or both, or whether the movement launch and short gathering were one action.
required_followup: Find permitted contemporaneous documentation of site-specific turnout, direct demand recipient and the relationship between reports; never count police/gendarmerie as protesters.

description: VOA reports the March 8 event date but no actual end date. Searches did not produce explicit event closure or continued activity; other towns are not merged into one national episode.
required_followup: Retain end date unknown unless a source explicitly describes physical closure or completed activity.

description: Searches returned an undated peace march by Northwest women in Yaounde, health and teacher strike leads, and the undated Ekona mothers protest carried from February; no search header supplies reliable date, public turnout or clear own-state demand.
required_followup: Verify date, actual public assembly, simultaneous turnout and demand recipient from permitted evidence; peace demands aimed at armed actors or workplace stoppages alone do not qualify.
